description.fallback: A maker's studio, front and back. Shoppers choose a piece, its material, size and finish, make it their own in the Customiser, and see when it will be posted; the studio proofs every piece with words on it, batches pieces onto the machines and posts them — every price and date decided by your own database.

help.fallback: The days the studio works, as a comma list: mon,tue,wed,thu,fri,sat,sun.

label.fallback: Orders start the same day before

help.fallback: A time on a 24-hour clock. An order placed after it starts on the next studio day.

reason.en-US: Shoppers make a piece their own: their words, their logo, a ready-made design.
Book DHL for a parcel, print its label, and send the shopper a tracking number.
Print a label for each piece and each parcel.
Keep sheets, blanks, filament and glaze in stock, with what each batch takes.
Send a receipt with each order, and print one from the dashboard.
Close the studio for public holidays in a tap.

overtaken.en-US: A later e-mail took its place

text.en-US: E-mail me news from the workshop: new pieces, and when we're away. Now and then, never more than once a month.
